The first name of '''Susa''' can refer to the following women:

* [[Susa al'Seen]] - a [[novice]] from [[Emond's Field]].
* [[Susa Wynn]] - a [[Murandy|Murandian]] woman who gave birth shortly before the end of the [[Aiel War]].
* [[Susa (tale)|Susa]] - According to a [[Gleeman]]'s tale, a woman who tamed [[Jain Farstrider]].
